plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: part-time driver until retirement at age 65 (as stated in Supplemental Statement)

injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

manifestations.description: mild residual numbness of left hand (ulnar two fingers / ulnar half of left hand)

treatments_received: physiotherapy treatment at Tseung Kwan O Hospital (TKOH)
anterior spinal fusion at C6/7 (12 October 2012)
anterior spinal fusion at L5/S1 (8 September 2015)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: ceased all these activities after the Incident (swimming, playing football and basketball, cycling and horse riding)
As long-time walking would aggravate his neck pain and back pain, he stayed at home most of the time which had greatly affected his social life.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: The neck pain and low back pain also affected his daily activities such as teeth-bushing and hair-washing which would involve movement of neck or low back.

comparable_cases.case_name: Luk Yee Lam v Orasa Livasiri
comparable_cases.injury_description: the taxi driver claimant suffered the whiplash-type injury to his neck which caused damage to the disc at the C5/6 level with residual pain in the neck and back, numbness in the right arm and left wrist, weakness in his hands, some numbness and pain in his right leg and his feet and reduced sexual desire
